$comment: Path→doc mapping read by doc-reminders.mjs (PostToolUse hook). `pattern` is a JS regex tested against the repo-relative path (forward slashes). `tools`: 'edit' fires only on Edit/Write; 'any' also fires on Read/Grep/Glob. Each rule injects its `docs` lines into context at most once per session. Per-directory traps belong in that directory's AGENTS.md (auto-loaded), not here — this map is only for docs that path proximity alone won't surface.

docs: docs/Testing/Testing Reference.md — required reading before writing or changing tests; use the /javascript-testing-expert skill
docs/Testing/Unit Testing How-To.md and docs/Testing/Property Testing Reference.md — supplement as needed
docs/Testing/React Testing Reference.md — component/hook testing conventions
docs/Documentation/How-To.md — kind selection, naming (Title Case + kind suffix), placement
docs/Documentation/Reference.md — quick-lookup naming and cross-referencing rules; lint gate is `vp run lint:docs`
Run ./scripts/checks/rust.sh before pushing (fmt + clippy -D warnings + nextest); cargo-deny (deny.toml) gates new dependencies — see the Rust section of AGENTS.md
docs/Messaging/Bridge Explanation.md — webview↔host bridge layering, FIFO channel, __Ready handshake, tag-uniqueness discipline
docs/Messaging/Wire Pinning How-To.md — required when adding/changing a message that crosses the TS⇄Rust boundary
docs/Effect/HttpApi Composition How-To.md — phantom-id bridge, cross-slice composition, topLevel collision
docs/Effect/OpenAPI Spec Drift How-To.md — regenerating committed snapshots
docs/Effect/Patterns Reference.md — repository pattern, generators, error wrappers, Layers
slices/AGENTS.md — layering rules (-core is pure; adapters import -core, never the reverse)

Run `vp install` after any package.json edit; for pnpm.overrides see docs/Dependencies/Version Override Explanation.md
